about: Every ability of the style-lab engine and how a chapter (templates/morph.js, the film's main body since the 2026-10-26 convergence) reaches it. Written because the convergence left the image-to-3D line, the model library, the Blender bakes and the screen media reachable from the old card route only (the user 2026-10-27: 系统怎么能把这环节丢掉呢 是不是还有很多重要的没接上). status: chapter (a chapter calls it by `chapter`), card (only the card route's 3D plates, stage.mjs: to wire), retired (not for new films, with the user's reason). A test fails when an engine file is in none of the entries, or a `chapter` path is not in the chapter kit; `run` lists what is still card-only.

the chapter itself: one continuous diagram, camera keys, moves

type roles and type in the scene (surfaceType); historical-font-replay is an explicit SHA-bound approved-module reproduction only, never a new-film lettering choice; shelf bay back/fascia material type via type.bayBackType (not HUD, not box plate)
the 2D evidence kit and the big-type moves (revealType, knockout, maskType, peakType, evidenceCard …)

the reference's devices as parts; 光郡's display grammar and Gawx's poster type (kit5.js, 2026-10-28); the type bible's grid (type.grid: columns, the five sizes, pairs)
finished compositions: globeRoute, chartTable, countField, queueFleet, heroObject

made models (kit.props.model: image-to-3D GLB, built by the line when missing, looked at before use: chapter.mjs modelCheck) and code stand-ins; helpers round a hull placed by rule (kit.props.formation: pushers at the sides, pullers off the ends, lines never across the hull)
any object as a textured model: reference views (GPT, text-free) -> Hunyuan3D-2mv -> GLB; views at one scale, proportions measured; reference views reviewed (asset_review) before Hunyuan

an object the library lacks built automatically as 2-5 parts that take apart (plan task, then image-to-3D per part)
